verify.note: Each hook against the original from one state: every register with R and all memory (the bitmap too) at the draw hook, the erase-only entries, the clear, the pace window's entries and ends and every draw from its entry; the object's sprites against the figure the original plots on an empty screen, in the object's colour; the colour paint's copy stores nothing and leaves everything else the game's; the IM 1 handler of the alt ROM image against Sinclair's at every interrupt; unit cases over every graphic.

status.title: Pssst
status.build: pssst_sprites.nex 76ef88e9 (the game draws as it does; every figure of the main object table a sprite on the same pixels in its own colour; the colour paint of those objects stores nothing; loading screen)
status.software: Verify IDENTICAL on two whole machine-played recordings (40,181 frames, 14 games of the first level): 111,080 figures as sprites, 13,019,621 sprite pixels against the original's plot, every register with R and all memory (the bitmap too) at every hook, the IM 1 handler compared at 36,814 interrupts; unit PASS (2,352 graphic cases over all 49 graphics, negative control 40 of 40); 6 of 6 broken builds detected; ROM path check pass
status.hardware: untested (the patch runs from its menu in OverSpec)
status.next: a recording played by hand into later levels; hardware test

techniques.target: the game's plotter and bitmap unchanged; each object's sprites lie on the pixels it plots, in the object's colour; the colour paint's CALLs for those objects go to a copy that stores nothing
HLIB_R_IN / hlib_r_set / HLIB_R_OUT in every hook (the game reads R)
HLIB_SPEED_IN at the plot's entries, HLIB_SPEED_OUT at their ends: the set-up runs at 28 MHz and pays for the draw hook
Sinclair's ROM as the alt image with the hooks at 0x386E (0xFF there); the game runs the ROM's IM 1 handler, compared at every interrupt

pacing.coverage: Two machine-played recordings (40,179 frames, first level); every pace site compared in the replay. No JNext or hardware timing.
pacing.result: The main loop is not frame-synced. The plot's set-up, a fixed stretch a draw, runs at 28 MHz and pays for the draw hook (as Jetpac 1.3); the colour paint's copy takes the original's time to the T state. Not measured as a whole.

dependencies.coverage: Every screen writer of the first recording (survey); every CALL and JP from the handlers into the plot code listed; the colour paint's nine CALLs and JPs and every pointer at a graphic checked by the build; all 49 graphics through the plotter in the unit cases. First level only in play.
dependencies.result: The bitmap and all game memory but the colour cells of the objects with sprites stay the original's. The game runs the ROM's IM 1 handler: the alt ROM image is Sinclair's. It reads R: every hook leaves R as the original. A 16K game: nothing reads or writes above 0x7FFF, where the hook RAM is.

feasibility.decision: As Jetpac's published patch (owner 2026-11-20: 'Let's finish off the ultimate games'): the game's own colours, moving figures as sprites; the flower, the leaves and the lives stay the game's.
feasibility.next_experiment: A recording played by hand into later levels; hardware: the checklist in games/pssst.md; the game's speed against the original over a minute of play: within 2%.
